verdicts.reason: Both are nearly the same broken leaderboard. The original's warm orange overlay is lost: the background is a dark, busy crowd photo with a random orange vertical stripe. 'RICHMOND HIGH SCHOOL THEATRE PRESENTS' is crushed to tiny text with one word per line. The play icon is blown up into the largest element and competes with the 'Pygmalion' title. The ticket text sits directly on the busy photo. A shrinks the frame graphic into a tiny box floating next to the title, which is meaningless. B's frame lines are cut-off fragments that butt against the 'g' of 'Pygmalion', which looks like a near-collision, so A is marginally cleaner.
